value_selection_logic.estimates: Designer estimate with explicit methodology and associated_sources.
value_selection_logic.unresolved: Relationship may remain visible at low opacity without implying a magnitude.

estimate_visual_logic.derived_source_supported: family colour plus subtle hatch or marker
estimate_visual_logic.designer_estimate: distinct estimate tint/pattern; still width-proportional to estimates

estimate_rules: Never replace a populated quantity with an estimate.
Use estimates only in the same unit declared by the row.
Do not sum incompatible unit families.
Show associated_sources and methodology_note in hover/popouts.
Estimates may use MIT global ratios only when scaled by a documented UK anchor.
Estimated values do not automatically contribute to formal stage balance.
